import json, os, sys, time, tempfile, hashlib, platform, resource, subprocess, datetime, importlib.util
t0 = time.monotonic(); ROOT = '/home/ryan/rule30-lab'
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS, (1073741824, 1073741824))
sp = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('oracle', ROOT + '/scripts/check_three_return_signed_mass_independent.py')
oracle = importlib.util.module_from_spec(sp); sys.modules['oracle'] = oracle; sp.loader.exec_module(oracle)
assert oracle.gen_t(1) == 7 and oracle.gen_u(1) == 6
for x in range(1, 1000): assert oracle.gen_t(x) == oracle.gen_t_bitwise(x)
def play(word):
    assert word[0] == 'u'; s = 1
    for ch in word[1:]:
        old = s; t = oracle.gen_t_bitwise(old)
        if ch == 't': s = t
        elif ch == 'u': s = t ^ 1
        else: s = t ^ 1 ^ (0 if old & 1 else 2)
    return s
w = 'uutuuttuupupuuupup'; z = play(w)
assert z == 0x6473d46ab and len(w) == 18 and z.bit_length() == 35
s = oracle.forced_zero_schedule(z)
assert s == 'ttttutututu' and s[4:10] == 'ututut' and oracle.admissible(s[:4] + 'utututu')
x = z >> 4
assert x == 0x6473d46a and z == 4*4*x + (z - 16*x)
assert z - 16*x == 0xb
levels = oracle.build_frontiers('u', 16)
assert x in levels[16]
bd = oracle.belief_direct(levels, 16, x, 3, [])
assert bd == oracle.belief_recursive(levels, 16, x, 3, [])
from collections import Counter
hist = dict(Counter(bd.values()))
assert hist == {0: 46, 1: 36, 2: 6}, hist
E = hist.get(0, 0) + hist.get(2, 0); O = hist.get(1, 0) + hist.get(3, 0)
N = E + O; S = E - O
assert (E, O, N, S) == (52, 36, 88, 16)
import math
v2 = lambda v: (v & -v).bit_length() - 1 if v > 0 else 99
assert v2(N) == 3 and v2(2*O) == 3 and v2(S) == 4
assert v2(E) == 2 and v2(O) == 2 and (13 + 9) % 4 == 2
cpu = next((l.split(':',1)[1].strip() for l in open('/proc/cpuinfo').read().splitlines() if l.startswith('model name')), 'unknown')
src = open(__file__).read()
summary = {'ancestor': ['u', 16, hex(x), 3], 'E': E, 'O': O, 'N': N, 'S': S, 'hist': hist,
 'v2_N': 3, 'v2_2O': 3, 'gate_holds': False, 'witness': ['u', 18, hex(z), 5, 4, [2, 2, 2]],
 'strip_bits': 4, 'k_diff': 2, 'L_diff': 2, 'belief_size': len(bd)}
rec = {'experiment_id': '20260905_restricted_gate_counterexample', 'timestamp_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 'git_commit': subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip(),
 'question': 'problem1', 'hypothesis': 'The named true ancestor violates the unequal-valuation gate while keeping nonzero mass.',
 'backend': 'python-exact-integers-direct-and-recursive', 'parameters': {'node': ['u', 16, '0x6473d46a', 3], 'witness': ['u', 18, '0x6473d46ab', 5], 'max_frontier': 16, 'generator_cases': 999, 'schedule_cap': 64, 'wall_limit_seconds': 120, 'address_space_bytes': 1073741824},
 'hardware': {'cpu_model': cpu, 'machine': platform.machine(), 'cpu_count': os.cpu_count(), 'peak_rss_kib': resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss},
 'software': {'python': sys.version, 'platform': platform.platform()}, 'runtime_seconds': time.monotonic()-t0,
 'result_hashes': {'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(src.encode()).hexdigest(), 'result_sha256': hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(summary, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode()).hexdigest()},
 'source_text': src, 'result_summary': summary,
 'interpretation': 'Restricted valuation gate refuted on a true ancestor; signed nonvanishing untouched (S=16).',
 'status': 'finite-exhaustive', 'proof_scope': 'One named belief by two implementations plus witness replay and strip check.',
 'limitations': ['Single case; no all-depth claim.']}

with os.fdopen(fd,'w') as f: json.dump(rec, f, sort_keys=True, indent=2); f.write(chr(10)); f.flush(); os.fsync(f.fileno())
